name: The Survival Train
description: A travelling apothecary and workshop, gathering the displaced across the broken country after the Shattering.
notes:
Named twice in canon and never modelled until now. `epoch_post_cataclysm` calls it what Varuna and Mitra turned to once they kept no power worth the name, and `mythology_varuna` puts an older Varuna at the head of it.

Canon also states its ending: the story finishes when the Train stops for good and becomes the centre of a village. That is recorded here rather than as a `states` block, because it is the last thing that happens rather than a second era -- and the event of it stopping is unwritten, like the rest of the Shattering.
